ingredients.title: Chicken
items: 1 small bottle Kraft Zesty Italian Dressing

ingredients.title: Sweet pork
items: 3 1/2-4 lb pork roast or boneless ribs
1 can diced tomatoes, undrained and blended in a food processor

ingredients.title: Dressing
items: 1 pkg ranch dressing mix, made with the buttermilk ranch directions

instructions.title: Chicken
items: Cook on low in a crock pot for several hours until chicken is tender and falls apart.

instructions.title: Sweet pork
items: Cook pork in a slow cooker until the pork falls apart.
Drain about 1/2 of the liquid from the pork.
Add the rest of the ingredients except the cilantro and green onions. Cook for at least an hour (longer is better).
Add green onions and cilantro right before serving.
Mix everything together and put in a crock pot. Roast for 7-9 hours (shred meat after 6-8 hours and let cook another hour).

instructions.title: Rice
items: Put everything in a food processor except water and rice.
Add to water and rice and simmer until done (about 30 minutes).

instructions.title: Dressing
items: Put everything else in blender and add ranch.

notes.title: Open questions
items: The sweet pork has two methods: cook the pork first and then add the rest, or mix everything together and roast 7-9 hours. I kept both in the source's order. Should one go?
There are no salad assembly steps (lettuce, tortillas, toppings). Add any, or keep it as the four parts?
